name: Permits & License Committee Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE MEETING
  SPECIAL MINUTES
  February 6, 2020

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, February 6, 2020,
at 2:01 pm in the Council Chambers, 9th Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Marissa Fewell, Planning & Building Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Marco Tan, City Treasurer’s Office

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Horton asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Horton reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit Request(s):

Item #1:  Daniel Farris DBA Woodworks Records LLC to host D Smoke’s Fan
  Appreciation and Community Give Back at Edward Vincent Park, 700
  Warren Ln., on Saturday, February 8, 2020, from 1:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m.; IPD
  staffing TBD, Watch Commander will be notified for extra patrol; Parks and
  Recreation staff TBD contact 8750; maintain site at all times, ensuring site
  is properly cleaned immediate at the end of event; and adhere to all State,
  Federal and all applicable IMC rules and regulations. (Activity No.
  00296498)

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:24 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
